titre: Le financement public de la recherche biomédicale américaine
sous_titre: Niveau de programme des Instituts nationaux de la santé, en milliards de dollars, exercices 2022 à 2026

2025.texte: NIH received a total program funding level of $47.035 billion in FY2025, $276 million (-0.6%) less than the FY2024 final level.

2026.texte: provided NIH with a total program funding level of $47.493 billion in FY2026, $458 million (1.0%) more than the FY2025 final level.
